newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Springbok rugby hero becomes crime victim.
newsitem.headline: Springbok rugby hero becomes crime victim.

text.p: The hero of South Africa's rugby World Cup victory, Francois Pienaar, became the latest victim of the country's crime wave when burglars ransacked his home while his wife cowered in a locked room.
Pienaar told reporters on Saturday night the burglars struck on Friday while he was out.
"It's been a traumatic week and things didn't improve when my house was broken into last night. My wife was there when it happened which was very worrying for me," he said.
Pienaar, one of the most successful captains in Springbok rugby history, learned on Saturday last week that he had been dropped from the squad to tour Argentina, Wales and France next month.
